answer: A watch-post will not sell cheap extra names. To book one night berth, a courier must finish an 11.6-kilometer river voyage, present one cut lotus stem whose vein map is photographed at embark, and seat a 31-gram onyx pebble in a numbered tray after locking 16.8 POA for 30 hours. Clerks overlay the vein photo on the embark plate and re-weigh the pebble to 0.2 grams. If two stems share a vein print, the pebble is off by more than 0.2 grams, or the funding key already failed two berths in five days, the bond is paid to four attesting lock-keepers and that key is barred for two epochs.
